comment: Dehydration relatively flexible, with hydrophobic flanking AAs preferred. Ser29 (non-dehydrated in vivo) could be dehydrated in vitro. Glutamate is also required as cofactor.

reactions.description: Dehydration of ser/thr in nisin A precursor peptide. Leader peptide with FNLD sequence ("box") essential for recognition.
Dehydration of the NisA precursor peptide. Ser29 is not dehydrated.
